Dear iwoca Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Full-stack Engineer role on your Operations Engineering team. Building the internal tools that let operations teams work faster is exactly the kind of problem I enjoy — and my TalentHiv project shows I can take one from idea to deployed product. I designed and built the full stack myself: a FastAPI backend with clean REST structure, PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations, and a Next.js/React/TypeScript frontend, deployed to Azure App Service with Key Vault. I also built in GDPR data export and deletion to meet regulatory requirements.

I use AI daily in my development flow — LangChain, Azure OpenAI, and AI coding assistants — to move fast on boilerplate and focus on architecture. My VoiceHive Hotels project further deepened this: a FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Docker backend integrating GPT-4, designed for scalable, cost-effective operation.

Before retraining as a developer, I spent 20 years at Casino Cosmopol leading operational teams of 50+ in a strictly regulated environment. That taught me to understand operational workflows from the user's side — which internal tools break, why, and how small automations remove manual effort. I'd bring that perspective plus strong Python, React/TypeScript, and PostgreSQL skills.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
